title: Browser cache serialization and relay teardown correctness
observed_behavior: Control-plane collection entries are stored in deeply reactive Svelte $state arrays.
The IndexedDB adapter receives those reactive Proxy entries directly and browser structured cloning rejects them with DataCloneError.
The in-memory cache test adapter JSON-serializes records, masking the browser-only failure.
Repeated PoolBackedClient.disconnect calls destroy the same externally supplied pool more than once.
intended_behavior: Bahia persists plain snapshot DTOs rather than reactive application state.
Browser IndexedDB writes and reads reactive LLM route data without warnings or data loss.
Disconnect remains safe and idempotent while preserving subscription and pool cleanup.
